knn_amd_legacy_schedule.status: new default K1 (plan flagship-gaps-2026-10-09 kNN K1)
knn_amd_legacy_schedule.note: Rollback arm: AMD back to its old IDENTICAL kNN rows (query tile 256, no radix scratch shrink, no resident derived cache, generic-K selector without warp-bound guard, no bound-and-compact at k>=17, 4 register rows, scalar index loads). Default: AMD takes NVIDIA's rows. Kept per-vendor: hardware FTZ FMA (NVVM instruction, no AMD spelling) and the AMD smem tile d>=32 gate (measured AMD loss). NVIDIA build unchanged by this control.

knn_scratch_pool_off.note: Rollback arm: per-call allocation of queries, norms, dist_tile, radix pairs, outputs and pinned readback on every resident search. Default: exact-length views of the handle's high-water pool.

knn_widek_radix.note: On a 64-lane column (AMD CDNA) k>=17 column-tile selection by the radix selector (scratch shrink skipped there). NVIDIA build unaffected (32-lane). Same composite-key total order.

knn_amd_block_topk_all_k.note: AMD column only: block top-k serves k up to 64 (no distance matrix, no selector launch) where the smem tile runs (d>=32 on AMD). NVIDIA keeps 16.

knn_amd_exact_chain.note: AMD column only: the register tile (d<32 on AMD) admits proven tiles to the unflushed chain. Time on taxi-like narrow rows.

xprep_pinned_upload_off.note: Rollback arm: DeviceStore put/write copy from the caller's pageable pointer. Default (not FAST, not Apple): >=1M-word puts through a 2 x 32 MB pinned stage, memcpy overlapped with DMA. Every DeviceStore binding (x_prep, x_metrics, model selection).

xprep_arena_pool_off.note: Rollback arm: fresh device arena per program and free-at-once store slots. Default (not FAST): exact-size pooled arena (core/device_pool.mojo, 2 GB idle cap) and spare slot buffers (2 GB idle cap).

xprep_no_slot_hop.note: Large direct inputs go host -> arena through the pinned stage (no slot, no D2D, no second X allocation). Python routes by the presence of x_prep_run_ranges_host.

xprep_device_codes.note: GaussianNB.fit classes and codes from the base binding's device unique_inverse instead of the host native encoder sort, for int/float label vectors. Python routes by the presence of x_prep_device_codes.

classical:knn.route: neighbors.py kneighbors -> knn_search_resident -> _knn_search_on_device_index (K4 pool) -> brute_force_knn_impl -> tiled_brute_force_knn (resident cache) -> smem/register distance tile + bound-compact | small-k | radix (K2) | block top-k (K3) + partial merges
classical:knn.notes: Diagnostic first: one AMD build with -D MOJOLEARN_KNN_PHASE_TIMERS (existing, vendor-neutral) splits transpose/distance/select/merge/upload. K2/K3/K5 move the AMD build only.
